summary: GameObject constructor. Writes vtable pointer off_5B47E8 into the object header at this+0, then reads flag byte at this+0x24EC; if non-zero, calls DeferredDeactivation and returns its result, otherwise returns 0.

operations.description: Write vtable pointer off_5B47E8 into the object header at this+0.
Read flag byte at this+0x24EC and branch on its non-zero value.
If the flag byte is non-zero, call DeferredDeactivation and propagate its return value.
Return the flag byte value (0 when no deactivation) or the DeferredDeactivation result.
